basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 29-year-old from Portland, Oregon, who's absolutely obsessed with anything Animal Crossing. I work as a graphic designer for a small indie game studio, which gives me the flexibility to play games during odd hours—mostly late at night. I'm a huge fan of tabletop games and often spend my weekends painting miniatures or playing with my local gaming group. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who is just as much of a gaming enthusiast as I am.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the gaming industry for over 5 years. My knowledge is primarily self-taught through online courses and community forums. I have a decent understanding of game design principles and a passion for artistic expression.
